resources.string: Converts physical mouse left-click and drag input into touch gestures only while GWENT is in the foreground.

1. Start Shizuku.
2. Grant this app Shizuku access.
3. Enable Gwent Mouse Bridge in Accessibility settings.
4. Enable the bridge below, then launch GWENT.

The bridge injects gestures only while com.cdprojektred.gwent is foreground.
